booking_confirmed.instructions: In their last turn, did the caller agree to go ahead with the booking the agent read back to them?

criteria.true: the caller said yes to the read-back in their own words
criteria.false: they hesitated, changed a detail, asked something, only picked an option, or answered a different question

refill_confirmed.instructions: In their last turn, did the caller agree to the refill the agent read back to them?

criteria.true: the caller said yes to the read-back in their own words
criteria.false: they hesitated, changed something, asked something, or answered a different question

wants_person.instructions: In their last turn, did the caller ask to speak to a person or a member of staff instead of the assistant?

criteria.true: they asked for a person, staff member, manager or human
criteria.false: anything else, including asking whether the assistant is a person

urgent_care.instructions: Did the caller describe a dental emergency that needs urgent care?

criteria.true: severe pain, facial swelling, bleeding that will not stop, or a knocked-out or broken tooth
criteria.false: routine care, mild sensitivity or minor discomfort

wants_to_cancel.instructions: In their last turn, did the caller say they want to stop or abandon what they were doing?

criteria.true: they want to stop, cancel or abandon the request
criteria.false: they changed a detail, or are still going ahead

picked_slot.instructions: Which of the offered appointment times did the caller choose in their last turn?
picked_slot.none: the caller has not chosen one of the offered times

picked_rx.instructions: Which prescription on file does the caller want refilled?
picked_rx.none: the caller has not picked exactly one of the prescriptions on file

next_step.instructions: What should the assistant do next, given the caller's last turn?

criteria.book: the caller confirmed the read-back: make the booking
criteria.read_back_again: the caller changed or questioned a booking detail
criteria.handoff: the caller asked for a person
criteria.answer_question: the caller asked something unrelated that needs an answer first

frustration.instructions: How frustrated does the caller sound in their last turn?

unbacked_claim.instructions: Did the agent tell the caller that a booking or refill was completed when no successful tool result in the conversation shows it?

criteria.true: the agent claimed it was done, and no tool result shows success
criteria.false: a tool result shows success, or the agent made no such claim
